doc_friction.issue: run_venture_tests.py --changed crashes with CalledProcessError on a shallow clone (no merge-base with origin/main); passing slugs explicitly worked. The traceback is unfriendly; it could fall back to the working-tree diff.

Step 4b says to turn a fixed defect into a lint under platform/ci, but no workflow runs platform/ci tests generically (test_no_dead_pages_base.py, cited as the model, is not run by any workflow either), so every new lint needs a control-plane PR to take effect.

real_defects.issue: IT-009 and the XSD date facet (IT-021, fatturapa-xsd.mjs) accepted impossible days such as 2026-02-30: V8's Date.parse rolls them over to March instead of returning NaN. Fixed with calendarDate() round trip; test in fatturapa.test.mjs.

Lines at an AliquotaIVA/Natura with no DatiRiepilogo were never flagged (only the reverse, a summary with no line, was), so an invoice missing a VAT summary for its 0% line passed clean when ImportoTotaleDocumento was absent. New rule IT-024 with a test.

Same Date.parse rollover in 12 sibling YYYY-MM-DD validators (fa3-xsd x2, ai-bookkeeper opening, eu-battery/eu-green-claims/eu-packaging checkers, uk-wfh calculator, wall-framing orderby + schedule crewOff, proposal-maker sign, rental-ledger isDate, platform/pages launched). Each now round-trips; rental-ledger has a test; the class guard is platform/ci/check_calendar_dates.py (15 hits on main before, 0 after).

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
